# Whyzo Creations

> Minimalist Creative Media & Web Studio operating at the intersection of 8K cinema, digital media, AI synthesis, and high-craft web design.

## Overview
- **Name**: Whyzo Creations (Whyzo Creatives)
- **Website**: https://whyzocreatives.com
- **Disciplines**: Commercial Videography, Editorial Photography, High-End Video Editing, Minimalist Graphic Design, Spatial Web Design, Generative AI Video Creation, Full-Stack WebGL Development.
- **Global Hubs**: New York (SoHo Studio), London (Shoreditch Hub), Dubai (Design District), Tokyo (Shibuya Lab).

## Key Services
- **Videography**: RED Cinema & Sony FX Series 8K RAW commercial films, brand documentaries, anamorphic multi-camera productions.
- **Photography**: 100MP medium-format editorial lookbooks, F&B culinary art, automotive track, and executive studio portraiture.
- **Video Editing**: Hollywood-grade post-production, DaVinci Resolve 16-bit color science, spatial sound design, and narrative pacing.
- **Graphic Design**: Minimalist brand identities, Swiss grid systems, international typography architecture, vector precision.
- **Web Design**: Spatial UI/UX design systems, Figma master kits, dark aesthetic micro-interactions, conversion-focused design.
- **AI Video Creation**: Next-generation generative neural video synthesis (Sora, Runway Gen-3, Kling), digital avatars, fluid particle VFX.
- **Web Development**: Lightning-fast custom web applications engineered with React 19, Vite, Three.js custom GLSL shaders, Tailwind CSS, and Lighthouse 99+ ratings.

## Portfolio Highlights
- **AURA Mixology & Culinary Cinema**: Ultra-dark aesthetic culinary film and photographic series (+3.4M impressions).
- **Veloce Hypercar Synthetic Reveal**: Combined synthetic neural AI rendering with real-world track videography (1.2M organic views).
- **Monochrome Haute Couture Runway**: High-contrast studio portraiture for Paris Fashion Week runway collateral.
- **Nocturne Global Music Festival**: 12-camera live video editing and LED visuals for 45,000 attendees.
- **Neural Synthesis Cybernetic Sequence**: GenAI Film Festival Best Visual Effects winner.
- **Kuro Tokyo Minimalist Identity & Stills**: Packaging, slow-motion brewing videography, and e-commerce platform.
- **Apex Racing Track Day Pursuit**: 120mph FPV drone tracking shots on Nürburgring.
- **Spatial Three.js Digital Flagship**: Luxury dark spatial platform with interactive 3D particle shaders.
- **Solis Brutalist Architectural Film**: Monograph print & natural light architectural study in Zurich.
- **Kinetix Cybernetic Apparel Lookbook**: AI virtual styling with digital garment physics.
- **Zenith Horology Macro Cinematography**: Extreme macro probe lens cinematography capturing tourbillon escapements.
- **Obsidian Dark Design System & Web**: High-security institutional fintech platform ($2.8B AUM).
